BiblicalUsage: Ezer is the plain word for help, and it runs through Scripture from the first chapters to the last. Moses named his son Eliezer because God was his help against Pharaoh's sword in Exodus 18:4, and Moses blesses God as Israel's help in Deuteronomy 33:26. The psalmist looks to the hills and says his help comes from the LORD in Psalms 121:2, and Daniel sees God's people helped with a little help in trouble in Daniel 11:34.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe help is one of the truest names for what God is to us. He does not only command and judge; He helps, and the Bible says so in the plainest word it has. When I have no strength left, my help comes from the LORD, not from myself.
